scope: Tesla Charge Companion V9 German CPO first-pass

this_pass.evidence: Current official Stadtwerke Lübeck charging page explicitly publishes contract-free direct charging: AC EUR 0.55/kWh plus EUR 0.10/min from minute 241, DC EUR 0.65/kWh plus EUR 0.10/min from minute 181. The standing-time surcharge is suspended from 20:00 to 08:00. Direct payment is supported by Girocard, QR code and, at equipped sites, debit/credit-card terminal.

Current official e-mobility page publishes direct payment via m8mit for its documented DC fast-charging offer: EUR 0.702/kWh gross, plus EUR 0.10/min blocking after 4 hours capped at EUR 12. QR activation and direct payment by SMS/credit card/PayPal are documented. Scope is restricted to the official DC offer; no AC tariff is inferred.

Current official public-charging page publishes exact spontaneous direct-payment tariffs. AC direct payment by QR is EUR 0.48/kWh with FairUse EUR 0.05/min from minute 181 during 08:00-20:00; start fee is zero except Preetz AC sites where EUR 0.70/session applies. DC direct payment by QR is EUR 0.58/kWh with FairUse EUR 0.10/min from minute 60 around the clock; start fee is zero. App/card roaming tariffs remain separate.

Current official tariff sheet effective 2026-02-01 publishes the Flensburg charging-card product at EUR 0.39/kWh AC and EUR 0.49/kWh DC plus EUR 0.10/min after 240 minutes capped at EUR 12. The official FAQ states prices with other providers depend on that provider. Current station-level discovery shows contract-free prices can differ, so the card tariff is not promoted to ad-hoc.
this_pass.reason: current own-network card tariff is exact, but no authoritative operator-wide contract-free direct-payment matrix was established
